_comment: Curated waypoints. Coordinates are NOT typed in here: prepare_data.py resolves each entry from the NASA rover waypoint record with the given site/drive, so every location comes from a published localization. Science text is a short paraphrase of the cited sources; read the sources for authoritative wording.

habitat.name: Hypothetical habitat (placed at Octavia E. Butler landing localization)
habitat.note: No habitat exists on Mars. Placed at the rover's first localized position after landing (site 3, drive 0, sol 13) so the origin sits at a well-documented, flat crater-floor location.

sites.name: Wildcat Ridge (delta front)
sites.location_basis: Rover localization at site 26 / drive 1222 (sols 502 onward), the parking position during the Wildcat Ridge abrasion and coring campaign. The outcrop is within metres of the rover, not exactly at this point.
sites.science_summary: Layered, fine-grained sedimentary rock at the front of the Jezero delta, interpreted as mud and fine sand deposited in an evaporating lake. SHERLOC made the mission's most abundant organic-molecule detections to date on the Berry Hollow abrasion patch. Cores 'Hazeltop' (kept on the rover) and 'Bearwallow' (later placed in the Three Forks depot) were collected here.

sites.name: Three Forks Sample Depot
sites.location_basis: Rover localization at site 32 / drive 250 (sol 654), at the start of depot operations. The 10 tubes were dropped at mapped spots spread over the depot area between sols 653 and 690.
sites.science_summary: A flat area near the base of the Jezero delta where Perseverance laid down 10 duplicate sample tubes (rock cores, regolith, atmosphere and a witness tube) as a backup cache for Mars Sample Return. It is a reference point for a planned retrieval stop, not an outcrop.

geology_unit_notes.Njf: Jezero floor unit: crater-floor unit interpreted by the map authors to underlie the fan units; published age estimates range widely (see pamphlet).
geology_unit_notes.NHjf1: Jezero fan unit 1: topographically lower, older member of the Jezero fan (delta) deposits.
geology_unit_notes.NHjf2: Jezero fan unit 2: topographically higher, younger member of the Jezero fan (delta) deposits.
geology_unit_notes.Nle: Lower etched unit: olivine-rich unit found only inside Jezero crater, the stratigraphically lower complement of the upper etched unit.
geology_unit_notes.Nue: Upper etched unit: widely occurring olivine-rich unit with several surface textures.
geology_unit_notes.Aeb: Eolian bedform unit: young windblown bedforms (for example transverse aeolian ridges).

sample_sites.name: Rochette
sample_sites.science_summary: The first rock cores ever collected on Mars for return to Earth. The salts in this lava-like rock show that groundwater moved through it long ago.

sample_sites.notes: Montdenier was cored sol 190 (31 Aug 2021) and sealed sol 194, after the team took extra images of it first. Montagnac was cored and sealed sol 196. NASA's sample table gives the sealing sols (194/196). Both cores share one coordinate, at abrasion patch Bellegarde. Montdenier went to the Three Forks depot.
sample_sites.location_basis: Rover position printed in the Mars 2020 Initial Report for the sol 190 coring; rover site/drive from the last localization on or before that sol.

sample_sites.name: Brac
sample_sites.science_summary: A coarse olivine-rich igneous rock that formed when crystals settled in a thick melt or magma body. It was altered by water afterwards, which makes it a key rock for dating the crater floor.

sample_sites.name: Issole
sample_sites.science_summary: A second pair from the olivine-rich Seitah unit. Collecting it was delayed after pebbles jammed the rover's bit carousel following the first core.

sample_sites.name: Amalik
sample_sites.science_summary: A fine-grained lake sediment from the delta front with sulfates and possible organic signals. It adds to the delta's record of past water chemistry.

sample_sites.name: Hidden Harbor
sample_sites.science_summary: A sulfate-cemented, very fine-grained sediment from the delta front. It records how salty water moved through the delta.

sample_sites.name: Observation Mountain
sample_sites.science_summary: The mission's first regolith (loose surface material) samples, taken from a wind-blown sand ripple. Future human missions need this to understand Mars dust and soil hazards.

citations.title: NASA Science: Mars Rock Samples (Perseverance sample table)

Mars 2020 Initial Reports, Vol. 2: Delta Front Campaign (PDS Sample Dossier)

sample_sites.notes: Collected with the regolith bit. Regolith work ran in two phases (sols 593-606 and 632-641). Atmo Mountain was collected and sealed sol 634, Crosswind Lake sol 639. The Initial Report's sealing line for Crosswind Lake says 'Sol 629', which looks like a typo for 639: it is before the collection date and conflicts with NASA's table. The 'Hidden Harbor/regolith' item in the brief is really two entries: Kukaklek (Hidden Harbor) and these regolith tubes (Observation Mountain). Atmo Mountain went to the Three Forks depot.
sample_sites.location_basis: Rover position printed in the Mars 2020 Initial Report for the sol 634 coring; rover site/drive from the last localization on or before that sol.

sample_sites.name: Berea
sample_sites.science_summary: The first sample from the upper fan, a sedimentary rock carried in by the river system that built the fan. It gives a view of material from Jezero's watershed.

sample_sites.name: Emerald Lake
sample_sites.science_summary: The first conglomerate core: pebbles cemented together, carried by a fast river. The pebbles may come from rocks far outside Jezero crater.

sample_sites.name: Hans Amundsen Memorial Workspace
sample_sites.science_summary: The first sample from the margin unit, a carbonate-rich deposit along the inner edge of the crater. It may have formed at an ancient lake shore.

sample_sites.name: Turquoise Bay
sample_sites.short: Carbonate- and silica-bearing sandstone · Margin unit
sample_sites.science_summary: A coarser margin-unit sandstone with abundant carbonate and fine-grained silica, two minerals that are good at preserving signs of ancient life.

sample_sites.notes: Drilled on sol 942, per the Initial Report's anomaly note. Arm (SHA) faults kept the tube open until it was sealed on sol 949, which is the sol in both the designation M2020-949-26 and NASA's table (21 Oct 2023). The report coordinate matches the sol-933 final waypoint (site 46 drive 0); the rover had not driven by sol 949. sample_sites.name: Tablelands
sample_sites.science_summary: A serpentine-rich rock from the crater rim. Serpentine forms when water reacts with iron and magnesium rocks, and such settings can produce hydrogen and support microbes on Earth.

sample_sites.campaign: Lac de Charmes (outside the crater rim)
sample_sites.short: Crystalline igneous rock · Lac de Charmes (outside the crater rim)
sample_sites.science_summary: The first crystalline igneous sample collected outside Jezero crater. It may be among the oldest rocks in the collection, possibly older than Jezero itself.

citations.title: NASA Science blog: Newest Sample, Oldest Rock?
The Planetary Society: Mars rover samples what could be one of the oldest rocks on the Martian surface

sample_sites.notes: Not in Initial Reports vols. 1-5 or NASA's sample table yet, so it has no sample number or designation. The NASA blog dates a coring-bit image to Oct. 24, 2026 (sol 2018), 'shortly after coring'. The Planetary Society gives the same coring date. The outcrop or workspace name is not stated: an earlier abrasion at 'Badger Peak' was too hard to core, and Singita came from a neighbouring rock about 100 m away (latest abrasion 'Pumbe', sol 2011). NASA's table and the mid-2025 tube count (33 tubes by sol 1574) suggest no samples between Gallants and Singita, and the blog calls Singita the first sample in more than a year. Rock type comes from the blog's account of the gabbro search and the Planetary Society's 'crystalline igneous', not from a formal classification.
sample_sites.location_basis: No Initial Report yet: rover position from the last NASA localization on or before sol 2018 (coring sol).
